Laura — quick heads up after I checked the generated ICS. The Meet link in the .ics is pointing to an internal token that requires the organizer's domain for entry (we had this with another tenant last month). If the Acme users import the file into a calendar tied to their SSO, Google sometimes refuses the embedded join URL and shows a "You need permission" screen.

Repro steps I saw:
1) Import acme-demo-20261117.ics into a Google Workspace calendar tied to external org.
2) Click "Join with Google Meet" from the event.
3) Page returns 403 / permission prompt.

Recommendation: resend a plain Zoom direct-join link in the body and reissue the .ics with the Zoom join URL in the LOCATION field (and include explicit dial-in instructions). I can regenerate the ICS if you want.

—Connor
